priceMeta.source: Yahoo Finance chart API query2; unadjusted local-currency close
priceMeta.membership: Current TOPIX membership and GICS classification from TPX500 Raw

meta.mcapMethod: Estimate 2026-08-28 start market cap as 2026-09-02 Bloomberg market cap times close(2026-08-28)/close(2026-09-02); assumes shares unchanged.
meta.contributionUnit: decimal percentage-point contribution to the 293-stock start-market-cap-weighted basket
meta.classificationPriority: Defense > AI/DC direct > AI adjacent > Other; exhaustive and non-overlapping

classificationRules.Defense: Material direct defense/aerospace systems exposure; defense wins when exposure overlaps AI/DC.
classificationRules.AI_DC_Direct: Actual delivery or construction into data-center end demand: communications/MEP/HVAC, optical and power cable, cooling, UPS/power conversion, fans, racks/enclosures.
classificationRules.AI_Adjacent: Second-order exposure through grid/electrical construction or semiconductor-fab equipment, cleanroom/water systems and factory automation.
classificationRules.Other: Residual Capital Goods constituents; includes generic construction, machinery and trading firms without sufficiently specific AI/DC exposure.
